task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is your task for today. Your first objective is to open the antique trunk. After pulling open the antique trunk, take the old key from the antique trunk within the bedroom. If you can get your hands on the old key, assure that the wooden door is unlocked with the old key. And then, look and see that the wooden door is ajar. After that, try to go east. Then, open the screen door in the kitchen. And then, attempt to go east. Then, try to head south. Then, retrieve the lettuce from the floor of the garden. And then, head north. Next, make an attempt to venture west. And then, sit the lettuce on the stove. That's it!
description:
You arrive in a bedroom. An ordinary one.

You can see a closed chest drawer in the corner. You see an antique trunk. You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a king-size bed. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though.

There is a closed wooden door leading east.
inventory: You are carrying nothing.

thought: I should open the antique trunk to find the old key inside.
action: open antique trunk
feedback: You open the antique trunk, revealing an old key.
